newsitem.title: USA: U.S. agency sets schedule for Conrail plan.
newsitem.headline: U.S. agency sets schedule for Conrail plan.

text.p: The Surface Transportation Board said it would consider the proposal submitted on Monday by CSX Corp and Norfolk Southern Corp to buy Conrail Inc according to a 350-day schedule.
Assuming the 23-volume, 14,810-page application is accepted as complete, and announced as such in 30 days, the board said its procedural schedule would be as follows:
-- July 23, Surface Transportation Board to publish in Federal Register a notice of acceptance of application.
-- August 7, notice of intent to participate in proceeding due.
-- August 22, description of anticipated responsive applications due.
-- September 5, preliminary draft environmental assessments for construction projects due.
-- October 21, responsive applications due; comments, protests and opposition arguments due; comments of U.S. transportation secretary and attorney general due.
-- November 20, notice of acceptance of responsive applications published in Federal Register.
-- December 15, response to responsive applications due; response to comments, protests and opposition arguments due.
-- January 14, 1998, rebuttal in support of responsive applications due.
-- April 14, 1998, voting conference, at board's discretion.
-- June 8, 1998, date of service of final decision.
